text.p: Masco Corp said Tuesday it expects to post significant improvement in both sales and earnings, and achieve record earnings for all of 1997, assuming the economy maintains its present rate of moderate growth.
The maker of home improvement and building products said sales and operating profits have continued to increase in early 1997.

Masco posted sales of $843 million in the fourth quarter of 1996, up 12 percent from the 1995 fourth quarter. Net income from continuing operations for the quarter was $83.4 million or $0.52 a share, versus $10.7 million or $0.06 a year ago.

For all of 1996, sales from continuing operations were $3.24 billion, an 11 percent increase from 1995. Net income increased 48 percent to $295 million from $200 million in 1995, before a $650 million non-cash charge in 1995 related to the disposition of the Home Furnishings Group.
